publish.title: AI is moving from chat to work
publish.caption:
AI is moving through three stages: ask → assist → execute. OpenAI's recent usage and enterprise reports point in the same direction: the useful layer is shifting from answers toward work completed inside real workflows. Save this framework if you're designing AI systems.
